name: Critical Failure: No Man's Land
summary:
A live action series controlled by a video game, the story goes from the game to the show Critical Failure like both worlds are one, allowing the viewers of the show at home to experience more through the game of the current timeline and story of Critical Failure. This is a game that evolves and changes as the story Critical Failure does. Each of the Critical Failure series of games will change as time does with each new release of an episode. Each time an episode changes, so will the games.

This game will remain a zombie survival game with constant improvements and new levels as the story evolves. 4-player multiplayer wave-based zombie survival game that you can always play solo.

With the added touch of the Drive-In Theatre, you will be given access to the content we release as it changes the game around you.

From the mind of Sinyster Soulutions Studios comes a brutal, wave-based zombie survival experience that bleeds directly into the universe of their hit show, CRITICAL FAILURE.

You aren't just playing a game; you are surviving the aftermath. As the show's narrative twists, mutates, and fractures, the game evolves in real time. Every lore drop, every catastrophic broadcast event, and every "critical failure" on screen rewrites the rules of your survival.

4-PLAYER wave based zombie survival that evolves with the shows episodic content release.
